summary: Fix directly matches the root cause described in the issue: bulk_update()'s isinstance(attr, Expression) check missed plain F() objects, which don't subclass Expression, causing str(F()) to be stored as CASE value instead of resolving the referenced column. The minimal one-line widening of the isinstance check to include F is exactly one of the two fixes the reporter suggested and is what upstream Django actually merged.

issues.description: isinstance(attr, (Expression, F)) is a narrower fix than duck-typing on hasattr(attr, 'resolve_expression'); any future non-Expression, non-F class implementing resolve_expression would hit the same bug. Not blocking since F is the only such case in current Django and matches the issue's proposed fix.
